title: Complaints
description: Triage, investigate, and resolve customer complaints.

empty.no_data_hint: New complaints submitted by users will appear here.
empty.no_results_hint: Try clearing the search or filters.

filters.search_placeholder: Search by complainant name or complaint ID

chat.title: Conversation
chat.empty: No messages have been exchanged yet.
chat.input_placeholder: Write a reply to the complainant…
chat.image_too_large: Image is over the 5 MB limit.
chat.send_failed: Could not send the message. Try again.
chat.locked_under_review: Start the investigation to open the chat with the complainant.
chat.locked_resolved: This complaint was resolved. The conversation is closed.
chat.locked_rejected: This complaint was rejected. The conversation is closed.
chat.locked_manually_closed: An admin closed this conversation. Reopen by changing the complaint status.

composer.shortcut_hint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for new line

socket_errors.AUTH_REQUIRED: Sign in again to continue chatting.
socket_errors.INVALID_TOKEN: Your session expired. Sign in again.
socket_errors.USER_BLOCKED: This account is blocked from support chat.
socket_errors.INVALID_PAYLOAD: Could not send the message — please retry.
socket_errors.UNKNOWN: Real-time chat ran into an issue.

force_logout.TOKEN_REVOKED: Your session was revoked. Sign in again.

notes.title: Internal notes
notes.subtitle: Notes are visible to admins only.
notes.empty: No internal notes have been added.
notes.form_description: Notes are never shown to the complainant.

start.title: Start investigation?
start.description: The complaint will move to In Progress and the complainant will be notified. Chat will be enabled.

resolve.title: Resolve complaint
resolve.description: Provide a short note that will be shared with the complainant.
resolve.note_placeholder: Explain what was done to address the complaint…

reject.title: Reject complaint
reject.description: Provide a short reason that will be shared with the complainant.
reject.reason_placeholder: Explain why the complaint cannot be accepted…

close_conversation.title: Close conversation?
close_conversation.description: The chat will be locked but the complaint will stay open for internal processing.

notify.title: Send a notification
notify.description: Sends a push notification to the complainant. This is not added to the chat thread.
notify.message_placeholder: We need more information from you about order #12345…

validation.resolution_too_long: Resolution notes are limited to 1000 characters.
validation.reason_too_long: Rejection reasons are limited to 1000 characters.
